race.description: Collins Court Butcher (N/P) Tg 5+W Series F Pr2 Di
race.comment: PAW NEBRASKA (2) has some solid form under her belt and proved too strong last time to win by 0.8 lengths at this track in a handy 23.22 beating MAGIC TOM. Well placed and can measure up. MAGIC TOM (1) jumped from this box and went down narrowly when a 0.8 lengths second (23.26) in a Other at this track over 400m latest. Expected to feature. PRINCETOWN FLYER (8) broke from the inside draw and filled a minor placing last start, beaten only 1.3 lengths (23.34) behind MYLES KEEPING at this track. The form out of the last run is proven to be strong. Overdue and gets her chance. MYLES KEEPING (5) racing over this course and distance brings the best out in him.
